title: Add RBAC v2 policy bundle v0.1 (default roles + permissions) + schema validation
author: Jordan Lee
description: This PR introduces the initial RBAC v2 policy bundle (v0.1) for Redwood Inference, including default role definitions and baseline permissions across Hosted/Dedicated/Private control-plane surfaces. It also adds a machine-validated policy schema, a lightweight validation CLI used in CI, and versioning notes to support future bundle evolution and Private/offline distribution. Scope: default roles only (no custom roles yet); action naming aligned with ENG-5383 conventions; policy evaluation semantics are allow-only with explicit deny reserved for future (documented). Deliverables included: (1) policy bundle artifact under bundles/v0.1, (2) schema + JSONSchema tests, (3) CI check to prevent invalid/unknown actions, (4) docs describing bundle versioning + compatibility expectations.
commits: policy: add v0.1 default roles and base permissions
schema: add policy schema + JSONSchema + golden tests
tooling: add rbac-bundle validate command + CI wiring
docs: add versioning/compat notes + contribution guidelines
